scope: DMC|M_plus and DMC|LiM_2plus real legs only

contract.admission_rule: admitted == every one of the seven gates is in passing_values; anything else stays unadmitted and the unmet conditions are listed verbatim

status_vocabulary.pending_reception: no audited staging record through the production entry (work not yet received)
status_vocabulary.staged: audited staging record exists and numerical QC passed, but the leg is NOT admitted to the ensemble
status_vocabulary.admitted: all seven gates pass; only this state may emit a candidate row
status_vocabulary.computed: FORBIDDEN in this file -- 'computed' is a property the pipeline derives from a real result, never a value a registration channel may assert

promotion.note: promotion is what puts the leg in front of the aggregator; it happens only on full admission

why_not_registered_eagerly: Every consumer of production_ensemble_candidates.csv keys on member_role in ('round1_extra', 'recovery_v1_start') and on source_kind.
build_production_ensemble_aggregator.build_rows() counts a registered candidate with no result as n_pending (line ~812-814), and any unresolved work makes the state provisional.
So registering a leg that is received-but-unadmitted as 'planned' would be a FALSE statement about the work, and registering it as 'computed' is what the round forbids outright.
The only truthful status today is therefore 'staged, unadmitted' -- which lives in THIS channel, not in the candidate table.

why_zero_candidate_rows: every registered leg is missing at least one of the seven gates; registration does not promote
rule: a leg is admitted only when all seven gates pass; 'computed' is never written by this channel, and the candidate table is touched only by admission
